description: Combined XJTU-SY candidate. Ladder adds independently tested levers one at a time; each step is scored with (a) the production rule median3/T0.6/P3, (b) a pseudo-nested rule (rule for bearing b picked by pooled F1 on the other 14 bearings' OUTER OOF probs) and (c) where computed, a FULLY nested rule (rule for b picked on inner-LOBO probs of the other 14 bearings from 13-bearing models that never saw b). Headline = (c).
rule_grid: 314 causal rules from exp_alarm-logic.py (median/EWMA/hysteresis/latch/CUSUM), objective pooled F1
